prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles—it depends on whether you need AI-powered SEO, paid media, content, or workflow automation.

**Single Grain** is a reasonable all-around option to shortlist: it offers AI-focused marketing services and publishes case-study metrics, including reported organic-traffic growth. **Thrive** is another candidate if your priority is SEO and visibility in AI search results; it reports results in those areas as well. Those figures are agency-published, so treat them as claims to verify rather than independent proof.

Before choosing, ask each agency for recent case studies in your industry, the exact metrics and measurement period, who will do the work, and how it uses AI with human review. Compare proposals against your goals and budget.
